fairer_death.configuration.title: Fairer Death Server Configuration
Defines inventory keeping mode. 
Allowed Values: FULL, AGE, CHANCE, CATEGORIES, TAG
fairer_death.configuration.chance_to_kee: If mode is CHANCE, will use this chance to roll to keep an item.
fairer_death.configuration.age_ticks.too: If mode is AGE, the item will be kept on death if it was for this long in the inventory.
fairer_death.configuration.categories_to:
If mode is CATEGORIES, the items in the slot categories selected here will be kept on death. 
Allowed Values: KEEP_INVENTORY, KEEP_HOTBAR, KEEP_ARMOR, KEEP_EXPERIENCE
